summary_1line: Pandava warriors charge Bhishma while Kaurava champions intercept them; Arjuna clashes fiercely with Dussasana before the advance toward Bhishma stalls.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna, with arrows lodged in his forehead like peaks on Mount Meru, stands blazing on his chariot as he duels Dussasana amid the raging battlefield.
Pandava heroes—Sikhandin, Abhimanyu, Dhrishtadyumna, and others—charge together toward Bhishma’s chariot while Kaurava warriors rush forward to block them.
Wounded and overwhelmed, Dussasana retreats toward Bhishma’s chariot as if reaching an island in a stormy sea of battle.
